existing_operation_only: If complete errors later justify it, a node-context-conditioned member mixture or hidden-state fusion is an attributed HGEN/SAGMM/stacking adaptation. It does not reopen closed final-head/query-value recipes by tuning.
mandatory_independent4_control: Train exactly the same learned aggregator architecture, context inputs, task/own-loss definitions and weights, gradient permissions, roles, initialization/seed opportunity, precision/optimizer/scaler/schedule, complete selection and serving contract for four truly disjoint member bodies. A common aggregator within an arm couples risk but does not share member-body parameters. Apply no extra gate/labels/selector/capacity only to the shared bank.
name_and_reference_limit: An untied4 with joint aggregation gradients is a new matched control definition, not the sealed original own-only independent4 recipe or arbitrary four single fits relabeled. Native independent4 remains a competent capacity reference; do not modify those sources.
TRAIN_supervision_only: Aggregator loss uses permitted TRAIN targets; gate inputs use deployment-available scores/states, features and graph context. No per-query truth/oracle member ID, TEST targets, development-supervised gating, teacher, independently fitted-ensemble-first stage or unmasked propagated query label. TRAIN error-label context would need common query exclusion/cross-fitting and is not proposed here.

columns: Same learned aggregator with graph context
minimal_identification_table.purpose: Graph-context gain relative to scores-only in each ownership setting and sharing interaction under the same learned aggregation opportunity. Use complete existing controls only if their contracts match; no silent anchor reuse.

strong_controls: Global scalar weights and native mean probability/logit rules under explicit matched serving
Capacity/information-matched nonlinear score/context stacker if hidden-state fusion is proposed
Same-context classifier with member information erased/replaced by pooled state, to detect new context-classifier capacity rather than conversion of complementarity
Competent same-operator single and complete native independent4 capacity references
Calibration/temperature control when gains are explained mainly by confidence
functional_success_and_falsifier: Require full served-quality/competence/calibration and net signed repairs over complete potential-harm rows, with useful graph-context gain beyond scores-only. Matching scores-only/context-erased controls leaves the graph/complementarity explanation unsupported. Matching or losing to independent4 with identical aggregator leaves sharing advantage unsupported. If no correct or hidden/context evidence exists, do not launch aggregation rescue.
no_new_coefficients_or_source_choices: No aggregator size, strength, split, horizon, model family or seeds selected here; no retuning closed recipes. Root must prospectively admit any distinct new task only after complete evidence.
cost: Charge all four complete member computations, aggregation/context construction, gradients, selection, every attempt and full serving/memory. Gate sparsity without actual per-node expert skipping does not establish savings.
